mapper.sql: id, record_id, user_id, source, name, address, latitude, longitude, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record_location ( record_id, user_id, source, name, address, latitude, longitude, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{recordId}, #{userId}, #{source}, #{name}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source = VALUES(source), name = VALUES(name), address = VALUES(address), latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
